ScenarioDef.label: Endless night
ScenarioDef.description:
For some time now, you've been trapped in this rimworld, locked in an endless cycle of death and resurrection. An archotech experiment has transformed this world into a distorted vision of paradise where death never occurs. The sun doesn't shine here, as the sky is obscured by dense clusters of archites, which periodically descend "to offer a second chance" to all who perish. But even then, you were a special case; the mechanoids are closely monitoring your return to ensure you return whole, not as a mindless shell. (For this scenario to function properly, an <color=#8a8ae6>Anomaly DLC</color> is required!)
<color=#f5ffa2>Gameplay Effects:</color>
- Dynamically spawns xenotypes from the <color=#8a8ae6>XenoGenes</color> mod with 2% chance. This depends on quests, weather, tech level, pawns, buildings, factions, and many other factors.
- The only stone found in biomes is <color=#8a8ae6>vacstone</color>.
- All <color=#8a8ae6>resources</color> will be much <color=#8a8ae6>rarer</color>, and the mine <color=#8a8ae6>yield</color> will be much <color=#8a8ae6>lower</color>.
- Night is permanent, but all plants can grow in the dark.
- Gravship has a <color=#8a8ae6>nearly unlimited substructure limit</color>, and substructures don't require grav plates.
- <color=#8a8ae6>Mech bandwidth</color> has a fixed value of 999 and cannot be lowered or increased.
- <color=#8a8ae6>Backup</color> is triggered automatically in case of death and has no cooldown.
- In the presence of an anomaly, the chance of <color=#8a8ae6>shamblers</color> appearing is significantly increased, and <color=#8a8ae6>graveyards</color> will spawn on the maps.
- <color=#8a8ae6>Death pall</color> will last much longer and appear much more frequently.
<color=#999999>This scenario is a mini-mod that makes changes after it's launched. These changes are permanent for the session in which the scenario was launched.</color>
<color=#f5ffa2>Difficulty:</color> This is a medium difficulty scenario that requires advanced knowledge of vanilla mechanics and basic knowledge of XaG mod mechanics. And yes, the ability to read.

li.text: Having acquired the gravship, you decided to put an end to your torment. Now you have a chance to break free from the cycle. But was this cycle a burden to you to begin with?
